children: Poland's central bank is in wait-and-see mode and interest rates won't change soon, national Bank of Poland (NBP) Governor Adam Glapinski said after the bank kept interest rates unchanged.
Poland's central bank sees a stable tempo of GDP growth until the end of year while CPI could exceed the bank's target in coming months, he added.
